title: Why do our stomachs rumble when we are hungry?
angle: We will explore the physiological process of the migrating motor complex, showing how the digestive tract sweeps itself clean with pockets of air and liquid that produce those surprisingly loud sounds.
description: An engaging 8-10 minute science explainer exploring the physiological process of the migrating motor complex, showing how the digestive tract sweeps itself clean with pockets of air and liquid.
